verdict.rationale: Benchmark's own API docs show contacts can be written (a sign-up elsewhere lands in a Benchmark list automatically, and contacts have Read & Write permissions), and contacts can be searched by custom field. They do not document updating contacts, setting custom properties on write, or suppressing/unsubscribing contacts, and no OpenAPI spec was found. missing for 10: explicit contact update endpoint, custom-field write support, suppression/unsubscribe via API, production-scale evidence (batch/bulk endpoints, rate limits), published API reference, independent corroboration

support.subject: As a developer, I can create, update, and suppress contacts with custom properties through the API at production scale

citations.quote: they show up in the right Benchmark list automatically
Search contacts by email, custom field, list, status, or creation date.
Per-resource permissions: No Access, Read, or Read & Write (contacts, campaigns, reports, domains)
